prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_rf', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while CWT_rf leads in seasonal correlation (0.4454), creating a natural split for STL decomposition. The massive RMSE spread ratio and high model disagreement indicate that different models capture different aspects of the series. With concept drift detected and autocorrelated residuals across most models, STL hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit the additive decomposition while using mixed weighting (trend correlation for trend component, seasonal correlation for seasonal component) to combine the specialized champions.
